visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with a modern undercut hairstyle, dressed in a plain white t-shirt, stands in a room with warm, ambient lighting. He holds a rectangular, reddish-brown box which is identified as a calendar. Behind him, a shelf holds books and a textured vase, suggesting a home or studio office. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of the man's hands as he writes in a white notebook using a black pen. His arm tattoos are visible as he carefully scripts characters onto the page. The lighting remains soft and warm. (3) The man holds the calendar again, demonstrating how a page can be torn off. He gestures with his hands while speaking directly to the camera. The background shows more books related to the theme. (4) Close-up shots show the man's hands flipping through the calendar's pages. Each page features a unique photograph, often sunset or nature-themed, paired with large numbers and Chinese text. (5) A young woman with long dark hair and a green blazer appears, holding the calendar. She is positioned in the same warm indoor environment. She holds the product towards the camera while smiling. (6) Several shots follow showing the man and woman sitting together at a table covered in papers and letters. They appear to be reviewing drafts or concepts, laughing and interacting naturally. (7) The man is seen sitting comfortably in an armchair, reading a book. A soft floor lamp provides warm light next to him, and a bamboo blind is seen in the background. (8) The final sequence shows the calendar in its packaging, and then the man holding it once more, inviting the audience to pre-order, with the warm, books-filled background behind him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A calm, friendly male voice introduces the 'quote calendar', speaking with clarity and a moderate conversational pace. A gentle acoustic guitar and piano BGM starts immediately, establishing a sentimental and warm atmosphere that persists throughout the video. (2) The sound of paper rustling can be heard as the speaker interacts with the physical product. The male voice continues with a narrative tone, explaining the unique features of the calendar, specifically that each page can be a letter or postcard. (3) A clear female voice joins, providing additional details about the original bestselling book and the collaboration process. Her tone is professional yet friendly, matching the overall vibe. The music remains steady in the background. (4) The male voice returns to read emotional quotes from the calendar, dropping slightly in pitch and intensity to convey reflection. The BGM remains supportive with soft piano melodies. (5) Subtle 'whoosh' sound effects are used to mark visual transitions between shots of the product and shots of the people. (6) The video concludes with the male voice delivering a call to action regarding pre-orders for 2026, maintaining a positive and inviting tone as the music gradually fades to silence.
